senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (b. h.) Cain, son of Adam.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:5">Snh. IV, 5</cite> <he>שכן מצינו בק׳ וכ׳</he> for so we find with reference to Cain when he had killed his brother &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 37b:10">Ib. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מלמד שעשה ק׳ וכ׳</he> this use of the plural (<cite ref="D00891"><he>דמי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 4:10">Gen. IV, 10</cite>) shows that C. inflicted many wounds and bruises on his brother &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 2:3">Gen. R. s. 2</cite> <he>ובהו זה ק׳ וכ׳</he> ‘and void’ (<cite ref="Genesis 1:2">Gen. I, 2</cite>), this refers to Cain who intended to reduce the world to waste and voidness; a. v. fr.
